oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: token-metering-anomaly detected. tenant=zenith-edge pool=dedicated-sun-3 metric=token_count delta=+98% (5m). dashboard: https://redwood/metrics/tenants/zenith-edge

Maya SRE: ack, I'm paged. looking now.

Samira Khan: I'm 2nd on call — joining the thread. do we know customer impact?

Raj Patel: joining. do we have a quick sample of the increased requests?

Maya SRE: pulling logs. early sign: lots of repeated requests with different request-ids but same idempotency-key missing. possible duplication at ingress fallback. sample: 
```
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z request_id=rs-7f3 model=redwood-large tenant=zenith-edge tokens=1234 path=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z request_id=rs-7f4 model=redwood-large tenant=zenith-edge tokens=1240 path=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T09:10:13Z request_id=rs-7f5 model=redwood-large tenant=zenith-edge tokens=0 error=upstream-retry
```

Maya SRE: that last line looks like a retry that still got counted. digging into metering service.

Samira Khan: if meter is double-counting retries, customer billing could be impacted. can we throttle or isolate the tenant while we investigate?

eng-runtime-lead: quick note — we had a change in ingress fallback logic in last deploy (commit `c3f2a9b`) that changed how upstream retries are proxied. putting that on my radar.

Maya SRE: plan: 1) put tenant into isolation routing (no autoscaling burst, route to small-model fallback) 2) pause billing ingestion for tenant 3) start one-off reconciliation job to detect duplicate meter entries.

Raj Patel: +1. I can take the isolation routing. applying now: `rctl tenant route --tenant zenith-edge --policy isolate --reason "investigate metering"`

Billing Team Bot: billing ingestion paused for tenant=zenith-edge by Maya SRE. ticket #BILL-4721 created.

Maya SRE: running reconcile script: `python3 scripts/meter/reconcile.py --tenant zenith-edge --start 2026-03-15T09:00Z --end 2026-03-15T10:00Z --output /tmp/zenith-recon.csv`

Maya SRE: `head /tmp/zenith-recon.csv` shows: 
```
timestamp,request_id,model,tenant,tokens,ingestion_id
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z,rs-7f3,redwood-large,zenith-edge,1234,ing-901
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z,rs-7f4,redwood-large,zenith-edge,1240,ing-901
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z,rs-7f5,redwood-large,zenith-edge,0,ing-901
```

Maya SRE: same ingestion_id on three lines — dedupe key not applied in ingestion pipeline so all three increments counted. looks like the ingress is forwarding retries but preserving same ingestion id (or ingest service treating them as separate).

eng-runtime-lead: confirmed. root cause probable: ingress change `c3f2a9b` removed setting of `X-Idempotency-Key` header on retry path. metering relies on that header to dedupe. rollback candidate identified.

Samira Khan: mitigation options?

Maya SRE: immediate: revert `c3f2a9b` from ingress (hotfix), enable a temporary dedupe by ingestion_id in metering (safe guard), and keep billing paused.

eng-runtime-lead: rolling back ingress now (`deploy rollback ingress  c3f2a9b`). ETA ~ 5m.

Grace (TSM): I'll notify the customer (Zenith Edge) and tell them we're investigating. suggest we prepare potential credit if billing is affected.

Billing Team Bot: freezing account billing ledger for zenith-edge until reconciliation completes. created internal invoice hold flag.

Maya SRE: rollback completed. ingress pods back to previous image. verifying metrics...

Raj Patel: metrics looking better. token rate back to baseline within a single sample window. snapshot: `sum(tokens) 5m: before=1,240,000 after=12,300`

Maya SRE: enabled ingestion-side dedupe patch (temporary) via feature flag: `meter.ingest.dedupe_by_ingestion_id=true` to prevent any lingering duplicates while full fix lands.

eng-runtime-lead: putting a follow-up PR to restore idempotency header in retry path + a unit test for ingestion dedupe. PR: https://redwood/pull/9001. tagging for expedited review.

Samira Khan: confirmed no further spikes for 30m. monitoring continues.

Grace (TSM): emailed customer with summary and next steps. proposed a billing credit contingent on final reconciliation.

Billing Team Bot: Reconcile job queued: `/jobs/reconcile --ticket BILL-4721 --tenant zenith-edge`. ETA to final report 2h.

Maya SRE: postmortem owners: eng-runtime-lead (root cause + fix), Maya SRE (mitigations + verification), Billing (impact and credit finalization), Grace (customer comms).

Raj Patel: any immediate followups?

Maya SRE: TODOs: 1) merge PR & deploy fix 2) bake in ingestion dedupe permanently 3) update runbook for fallback logic to check idempotency header 4) Billing to reconcile and decide on credit.

Samira Khan: marking as resolved in channel for now. will reopen if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark: :credit_card:
